name: Parcel kiosk
concept: The Saint-Philippe newspaper kiosk (b21), 1989, fitted as the parcel kiosk: the vanilla NewspaperBooth_E_01_redyellow, a 4 m booth with its shelves, counter and hatch built into one model. It becomes the place where the town posts and collects parcels (the post-parcel prop, a clerk behind the hatch, a noticeboard). Later it also sells the tourist map (M14 follow-up): the pack item LF_TouristMap.et as a row on the kiosk shop counter, so a new arrival can buy the map that marks the town heard of. This card is the shell: the booth as an LF pack prefab and its own pack grid cell, with the proof file to re-shoot it. Pass 1 builds it out.

vanilla.furniture: none: the vanilla booth carries no Furniture child (shelves and counter are in the model), so prune.mjs has nothing to flatten or cut

host.front_note: Front +z like every building. The booth model is a long box (5 m along z): the glass and the street door are on the +z face as placed in the dossier; pass 1 reads the pictures and, if the hatch faces -x, says so here.

rooms.role: the booth interior: counter, shelves and hatch in the model; the clerk stands here in pass 1

interactables: parcel counter (post-parcel prop, tools/assets/post-parcel) with the parcel-post action, pass 1
kiosk clerk behind the hatch (an NPC with a dialogue), pass 1
tourist map for sale (M14 follow-up, after pass 1): LF_Everon1989/Prefabs/Items/LF_TouristMap.et as a shop-price row on the kiosk counter; docs/features/map.md says the kiosk does not sell it yet

looks.about: Re-shoot: toolscli look grid:parcel-kiosk --close 0 [--hour 22]; the room with toolscli look grid:parcel-kiosk --interior 234.5,0.05,76.38 --radius 3 --close 0 [--hour 22] (world space: the kit sits at coords 234.359 0 76.144, angleY -90 in Grid_parcel_kiosk.layer, so building (bx,by,bz) is world (234.359 - bz, by, 76.144 + bx))
